capabilities: Parse Q:/A: lines from any vault note into flashcards
Flip cards with a 3D animation to reveal answers
Score cards as got it or missed it and retry missed ones
Show an end screen with score percentage and cards needing practice
Track the last 10 sessions per note and shuffle cards
extras: Manual installation only (download release files into the plugins folder); no community plugin store install steps are given.
intentEvidence: Built as an alternative to existing flashcard plugins that lack a proper visual interface.
motivation: The README says it was built because existing flashcard plugins lack a proper visual interface.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in flashcard study mode, and the author says existing flashcard plugins lack a proper visual interface.
summary: Flashcard plugin that renders Q:/A: note lines as animated flip cards with got-it/missed-it scoring and per-note session history.
